overview: 금융보안원 해킹으로 금융사 정보가 유출돼 금융권 보안 점검이 가장 시급합니다. Barracuda ESG 취약점이 root 권한 탈취에 악용되고 있어 해당 장비의 긴급 패치와 점검이 필요합니다. 이어서 악용된 Outlook 제로데이와 SAP CVSS 10.0 취약점의 패치도 함께 진행하셔야 합니다.

exploited.name: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
exploited.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG) contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to invoke a configuration-import function and restore a crafted, compatible backup archive, resulting in unauthorized modification of the appliance’s global configuration. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-111560.

ko.title: Barracuda ESG 인증 우회 취약점(악용 확인)
ko.target: Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG), 패치 버전은 벤더 공지 확인 필요

ko.action: 벤더 패치 즉시 적용, 설정 변경 이력 점검 (CISA 기한 2026-11-13)

exploited.name: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
exploited.description: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

ko.action: 브라우저 최신 버전 업데이트 및 재시작 (CISA 기한 2026-11-24)

exploited.name: Barracuda Networks Multiple Products OS Command Injection Vulnerability
exploited.description: Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606

affected.product: Barracuda Load Balancer Application Delivery Controller (ADC)

critical.description: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP and ABAP Platform does not perform sufficient verification of incoming authentication assertions under certain configurations. This results in a high impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.

international.snippet: Four flaws that attackers could exploit without logging in were fixed today as part of SAP's monthly Security Patch Day—the vendor rates all four 10.0, the maximum CVSS score. Three are in the SAP NetWeaver application…

related.title: SAP Patches Critical ICM2SHELL, ProxyGate Vulnerabilities
SAP patches ICM2SHELL and PROXYGATE maximum severity flaws

international.summary_ko: SAP 월간 보안패치에서 인증 없이 공격 가능한 CVSS 10.0 취약점 4건이 수정됨. 이 중 2건은 원격 코드 실행이 가능함. SAP NetWeaver 사용 기업은 즉시 패치 적용 필요.

international.title: Russian Turla Hackers Use New Cereal Malware to Steal Emails From Government Exchange Servers

related.title: Turla hackers use new Cereal malware to spy on govt Exchange servers

international.title_ko: 러시아 Turla, 신규 악성코드 Cereal로 정부 메일 탈취
international.summary_ko: 러시아 연계 국가 배후 조직 Turla가 신규 도구 Cereal로 정부 기관 Microsoft Exchange 서버에 침투해 이메일을 탈취함. 국가 배후 Exchange 공격 가능성이 있어 메일 서버 침해지표 점검 필요.
